properties.name: aipersimmon.ddd.inbox.consumer
properties.description: This application's identity in the dedup key (consumer, source, message_key). Several services sharing one inbox table must differ here, or they suppress each other's processing of the same message. Defaults to spring.application.name, else 'aipersimmon'.

properties.name: aipersimmon.ddd.inbox.schema-validation
properties.description: Whether to check at startup that aipersimmon_inbox exists and carries the columns of the latest migration. 'validate' fails fast instead of at the first consumed message, on a listener thread; 'none' disables.

properties.name: aipersimmon.ddd.inbox.cleanup.enabled
properties.description: Whether to schedule the inbox cleanup. Off by default: dropping handled keys is a retention decision, not a default.

properties.name: aipersimmon.ddd.inbox.cleanup.retention-seconds
properties.description: How long a handled key is remembered (30 days). Must exceed the longest possible redelivery delay, or a very late redelivery is processed twice.

properties.name: aipersimmon.ddd.inbox.cleanup.batch-size
properties.description: Rows per time-sliced delete page. Many small transactions instead of one giant first purge.
